title: Settings
subtitle: Customize the app. Your choices are saved on your device.

language.label: Language
language.description: Language of the interface and of the interpretive texts.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Follow the system or pick the light (Day) or dark (Night) theme.

node.label: Lunar node
node.description: The true node follows the actual position of the nodes, the mean node is their smoothed average: they differ by a few degrees and can change a line. All charts are recalculated instantly.

hint.deep: Full descriptions with the system's terminology.

data.title: Your data
data.label: Delete all data
data.description: Removes all saved charts, labels, journal notes and settings from this device. Before you proceed you can export a backup from the People page.
data.confirmDescription: All saved charts, labels, journal notes and settings will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
data.wipeError: The data could not be deleted.

about.title: About
about.openSource: Human Design System is free, open source software: you can read, use and improve the code under the terms of the license.
about.privacy: Privacy: date, time and charts never leave your device. To search for a city only the city name is sent to the Open-Meteo service, never your birth date or time.

notifications.title: Transit notifications
notifications.description: A heads-up when the sky lights up something in your chart. It runs locally, with no server.

enable.label: Notifications
enable.description: The browser asks for permission only when you turn this on.

what.label: What to notify you about
what.channels: A transit completes one of your channels

bodies.label: Planets to follow
bodies.none: Pick at least one planet to get gate-change alerts.

notifications.noChart: You don't have a main chart yet: channel alerts will start once you have one.

status.denied: Permission was denied. To turn notifications on, allow them in your browser or system settings for this site, then try again.
status.unsupported: This browser doesn't support web notifications, so they can't be turned on here.

limits.title: What to expect
limits.closed: Alerts only arrive while the app or PWA is open (even in a background tab). Nothing arrives when the app is closed: that would need a server, which doesn't exist yet.
limits.ios: On iPhone and iPad, web notifications only work if you add the app to the Home Screen and run iOS 16.4 or later.
limits.iosNow: You're in the browser, not the installed PWA: add the app to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there to turn notifications on.

toast.denied: Permission denied: notifications not turned on.
